title: Ozempic Maker Novo Nordisk’s Investors Are Nervously Looking Into the Future
summary: Novo Nordisk’s chief executive, Mike Doustdar, is a year into a corporate turnaround. He says investors are still underestimating the promise of the company’s drugs.
